content.text:
Profile names now keep their capitals: `displayName({ name: 'Ada Lovelace' })` returns `'Ada Lovelace'`. `npm test` passes 3 of 3.

The cause was `clean()` in `clean.js`, which lowercased everything. `displayName` used it, so profile names were lowercased too. I removed the lowercasing from `clean()`, so it now only trims and collapses whitespace. The two callers that depended on lowercasing now do it themselves:

- **`handle.js`**: `makeHandle` still produces lowercase, hyphenated URL handles (`ada-lovelace`).
- **`search.js`**: `findUsers` still matches case-insensitively.

I also added a test in `test/profile.test.js` that checks both `'ada lovelace'` and `'Ada Lovelace'` come back unchanged.
